text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to hone our skills begins today.
As for Daiichi Ruby—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding a parasol, she looked delicate, as if
she were visiting a summer resort. I couldn't help
but worry if the heat was getting to her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: She's a totally legit rich lady!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this like, mad cute!?
Nailed it, woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, for real, for real!!
It's legit so adorbs!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So it IS that!?
Karuizawa? Like a Karuizawa concept!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, we gotta blow the rich girl away at
summer camp too!! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but
I don't quite understand what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am using a parasol to reduce the strain on my body
and devote all my energy to the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It sure does~☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...It's time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
let's begin our training right away, please.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Let us make this a fruitful training camp.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien, so salty!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: But it's cute, so my heart goes doki☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady, wait up!!
Take me with youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This will be an important time for me as well.
I must make a decision—
regarding what direction Daiichi Ruby should take going forward.
